text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of dreams that never come 
true. Everyone gives up somewhere along 
the way.

The older you get, the more you live 
within your reach. But—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Duaaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo takes the lead! However, this 
is where Twin Turbo's lead comes to an 
end!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaashaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No! It's not ending, not ending, not 
ending! Twin Turbo in the lead! Twin Turbo 
still in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is roaring ahead!!!! On this 
grand stage, her turbo engine explodes 
into overdrive--!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Complete combustiooooon!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo crosses the line in 1st 
place!!!! Listen to this uproar! Listen to 
this massive roar of cheers!

"Common sense," "talent," "the strongest," 
and "equations"... Everything has been 
overturned. That's right—

What mattered was 'never giving up.' To 
just burn everything I had.

Those who burned themselves out in pure 
savagery are the ones who made history.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!! We did it, we did it, we did 
itttt!!!!!!
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo... won...? Against a lineup like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —It is a miracle, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ikuno...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You know, don't you, Nature-san? Three 
years ago, Turbo-san...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm bored of training now, maybe 
I'll make a video or something.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, Trainerrr... No, no, nooo. I don't 
wanna go into the gate...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooooo! Turbo's trying her best! 
And yet it's still... not enough at 
aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so unfair~~~! This is totally 
cheating! Waaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Whimsical, gate-shy, and completely 
lacking talent. She lacked everything, to 
the point where even her debut was in 
jeopardy...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That Umamusume went on to conquer the 
Arima Kinen, overcoming this star-studded 
lineup."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If a genius making a dramatic comeback is 
a miracle, then...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A former mediocrity burning out completely 
to stand at the summit. That, too, is a 
miracle.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right... It might just be on par 
with a miracle...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, this great achievement is... a 
message to every single Umamusume, and to 
everyone out there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Don't give up," you mean?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!!!! Trainer, Turbo did it-!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I beat myself! I beat Teio! I beat 
everyoneeee!!!!! Praise me, praise me!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Totally, right?! 
Ehehehehe!!!!!!

I pat Twin Turbo on the head repeatedly. 
Her face scrunches up in pure delight, and 
then...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Twin Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio! You did... a great job too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, Turbo was stronger today, 
right? How d'ya like that, give up yet!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I definitely lost, but I wouldn't say 
I'm beaten.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even though I lost in such a huge 
race, right in front of everyone?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There was quite a gap in time, after 
all. Plus—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't—I won't give up. No matter how 
many times I lose, I will stand back up 
and keep chasing after it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's what I was taught to do. By my 
respected master!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Master...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose next time, Twin Turbo! Yes, 
you're the one who—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: She is my lifelong rival!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
My... greatest... rival... Tokai... 
Tei-o...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaahn, Teio!!! Say it again, say it 
again~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way... I don't wanna keep 
repeating this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: In exchange~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone! Let's toss today's winner 
into the air!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Gather around Twin Turbo, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy★ Toss 'em in the air, pop pop 
pop! High up into the sky, whoosh☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. As a celebration for beating our 
explosive, god-tier runaway lead!”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, Turbo is so admirable. So 
amazing. I won't give up either!

And so, not only her friends, but all the 
Umamusume who ran in the race gathered 
together—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!!! Heave-ho!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaah!? It's so high, so scary, I feel 
so floaty! But—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!!! Heave-ho!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
THIS FEELS SO GOOOOD!!!!!! Turbo is the 
BEEEEEEEEST!!!!!!
(UAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

The turf's most wanted criminal— uncaught 
until the very end.

Everyone burned that tiny miracle floating 
in the sky deep into their memories.
